claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition R-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F13; type EXPLICIT; PHYSIOLOGICAL/FUNCTIONAL; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: MIXED / CONFLICTING. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_scope: PRODUCT MISMATCH | PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN | mixed replication
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: Premium Grounding accelerates recovery from exercise.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: H27 direct acute null (product mismatch, different construct)
H06 48 outcomes with a nonstandard threshold
H16 pain occurred in both groups
H23 n=22 with a biomarker subset of 4
No registered, powered, exact-product recovery trial

evidence_items.text: Müller et al. 2019: randomised triple-blind, 22 sport and physiotherapy students (12 grounded, 10 sham), grounded versus sham sleep for 10 nights after downhill treadmill running; smaller decline in selected performance measures and a smaller creatine-kinase rise.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The strongest recovery evidence and the only clearly independent positive group, outside the core author network. Blood biomarker subset n=4.

evidence_items.text: Brown, Chevalier & Hill 2015 DOMS biomarkers (creatine kinase day 2 p=.04, neutrophils p=.05) and Sokal et al. 2013 lower urea at sampled timepoints.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Directionally consistent biomarker signals, but selected from many outcomes and timepoints.

evidence_items.text: Muniz-Pardos et al. 2022: randomised crossover in 10 elite male runners, grounded versus non-grounded shoes over a 20-minute run; no difference in oxygen uptake, heart rate, lactate, fatigue or running economy.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A direct objective null, but on acute performance rather than recovery and with a mismatched product. The freeze prohibits generalising a grounded-shoe null to all grounding settings.

evidence_items.text: Brown, Chevalier & Hill 2010: randomised double-blind pilot in 8 healthy young men with selected differences among 48 outcomes under a nonstandard threshold of at least 10 percent.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Extreme multiplicity and imprecision; a feasibility signal only.

evidence_items.text: No registered, powered recovery trial with multiplicity control and the exact product was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: No study addresses the advertised product or the general audience.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Sufficient for a bounded statement about eccentric-exercise recovery protocols; insufficient for the advertised general claim.
supporting: H23 independent randomised triple-blind recovery signal

detected.rationale: A 22-participant eccentric-exercise protocol in sport students is extended to recovery for the general advertised audience.
An established recovery benefit is advertised while the supporting trials are small and multiply tested and a direct objective test found nothing.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase for training and recovery support.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That faster recovery is an established, generalisable product effect.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Exercise recovery claims carry limited clinical risk; the main exposure is misplaced purchase reliance.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: A solid reading was considered on the strength of H23, an independent randomised triple-blind trial. It is rejected as primary because the advertised wording is unqualified for a general audience while the evidence is small, heterogeneous and includes a direct objective null.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL AND DECISIVE — the Steelman layer established a genuine independent positive trial and correctly limited the null's reach on product-mismatch grounds; the adversarial layer established that the trials are small, multiply tested and unregistered. Resolved as QUALIFIED, with the evidence state recorded as mixed.

scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A registered, powered recovery trial with multiplicity control and the exact product has not been performed.

verdict.verdict_summary: An independent randomised triple-blind trial reported a smaller performance decline and a smaller creatine-kinase rise over ten nights after eccentric exercise, supported by biomarker signals from other groups. A separate randomised crossover found no acute effect, but it tested grounded footwear and running economy rather than recovery. Bounded support exists in eccentric-exercise recovery protocols; the advertised general claim does not follow.
